none: PAS NLM-6CDDD0: Roman Coin: Commemorative Nummus of House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy. Coin. Commemorative Nummus of House of Constantine (306-361), issue of 330-340, Reece period 17. Obverse description: Helmeted bust left. Obverse inscription: [VRBS R]OMA. Reverse description: Wolf suckling twins, two stars above. In exergue: TRP, for Trier mint first officina. Cliff Reeves kindly identified this irregular coin. Diameter: 16.4mm, Weight: 1.35gms, die axis: 12
